answer: Random beacon checks and compute heartbeats stop forgery: a beacon picks 5% of slots each epoch, and picked agents must prove work in one hour. A sparrow trader passes with one heartbeat, but a forger must keep copies live. A jade merchant forging 100 identities pays 100 heartbeats a day, 3,000 a month, while honest agents pay one. Missed checks void the slot and burn its bond; a river trader with one honest slot keeps undiluted rewards.
